The '''skeleton knights''' are [[monster]]s fought during the [[Zemouregal & Vorkath]] battle in the [[Zemouregal & Vorkath#Siege phase|siege phase]].

Two of them guard the northern [[place of power]]. While normally unaggressive, they attack the player when the [[Undead giant (Battle of Forinthry)|undead giant]] at the place of power is engaged and the player is in their range.

In story mode they only defend the place of power. In normal mode they also attack the fort along with [[Skeleton warrior (Battle of Forinthry)|skeleton warriors]].
